meta.title: India Comprehensive Annual Financial Metrics Dataset
meta.coverage: FY 2015-16 to FY 2025-26 (Calendar Year 2015–2025 where applicable)
meta.fiscal_year_note: FY = April 1 to March 31. FY2016 = Apr 2015–Mar 2016
meta.disclaimer: For educational/research use. Verify with official sources before financial decisions.

key_events: China slowdown fears August crash (-5.9% Nifty single day)

monetary.note: Demonetisation Nov 2016 caused deposit surge and credit contraction

banking_sector.note: AQR (Asset Quality Review) by RBI began exposing hidden NPAs

key_events: Nifty Bank sector badly hit post-demonetisation

macro.note: Growth dip partly due to GST rollout disruption

govt_finances.note: GST launched Jul 1; full year collections partial

equity_markets.note: Nifty crossed 10,000 for first time. Bull run year.

banking_sector.note: NPA ratio peaked — worst year for PSB health

key_events: GST unified indirect tax launched Jul 1 2017
SEBI tightens P-Note rules — FPI inflows moderate

equity_markets.note: Large-caps resilient; mid/smallcaps destroyed by IL&FS crisis

debt_markets.note: IL&FS default caused massive credit spread widening

banking_sector.note: PSBs posted aggregate losses. NPA ratio at multi-decade high.

commodities.crude_inr_impact: Higher oil widened CAD and weakened INR

key_events: LTCG on equity reintroduced at 10% (Budget Feb 2018)
IL&FS default Sep 2018 — NBFC credit freeze
INR hit 74.5/USD all-time low at the time

macro.note: Weakest GDP growth since GFC. NBFC credit crunch hurt consumption.

govt_finances.note: Corporate tax cut ordinance Sep 2019; fiscal deficit missed target

equity_markets.note: Large-caps led by Sep 2019 corp tax cut rally

banking_sector.note: IBC and resolution improving; NPA ratio declining

key_events: 5 RBI rate cuts; repo rate fell 135bps to 5.15%

macro.note: Worst GDP contraction since 1979. COVID-19 nationwide lockdown.

inflation.note: CPI breached RBI's 6% upper tolerance band for most of year

external_sector.note: Current account surplus — rare event; low imports due to lockdown

equity_markets.note: India VIX hit 83.6 all-time high in March 2020

banking_sector.note: NPA improved partly due to moratorium & regulatory forbearance

commodities.note: Crude oil WTI futures went negative in April 2020

key_events: Nifty crashed 38% peak-to-trough; VIX at 83.6 ATH
V-shape recovery — Nifty recovered fully by Nov 2020
Retail investor surge; 10.5mn new demat accounts

inflation.note: WPI at multi-decade high; RBI kept accommodative stance citing growth

govt_finances.note: Capex push; disinvestment missed targets badly

equity_markets.note: Nifty crossed 18,000; MCap/GDP above 100%; IPO boom year

mutual_funds.note: SIP and folio growth accelerated with retail investor surge

key_events: India 2nd wave (Delta) April-May 2021 — briefly hit markets
IPO boom — Zomato, Paytm, Nykaa listed
All PSBs profitable for first time

monetary.note: Fastest RBI tightening cycle in modern history — 250bps in 12 months

equity_markets.note: India significantly outperformed global markets — resilient domestic demand

banking_sector.note: Banking sector healthiest since 2012; NPA at decade low

key_events: Russia invades Ukraine Feb 24 — commodity shock
FIIs sold record Rs 1.21 lakh crore — DIIs absorbed
Debt MF LTCG indexation benefit removed (Budget)

macro.note: Strongest GDP growth since FY22. Manufacturing and investment led.

govt_finances.note: GST collections crossed Rs 2 lakh crore for first time

exchange_rate.note: INR among most stable EM currencies

equity_markets.note: Nifty crossed 20,000; India became 4th largest stock market globally

debt_markets.india_jpmorgan_gbi_inclusion: India included in JPMorgan GBI-EM index Jun 2024 (announced Oct 2023)

mutual_funds.note: SIP crossed Rs 17,000 cr/month; industry AUM crossed Rs 50 lakh crore

key_events: India becomes 4th largest stock market globally
SVB collapse Mar 2023 — minimal India impact
New tax regime made default from FY2023-24
GST crossed Rs 2 lakh crore monthly first time

inflation.note: Food inflation remained elevated; core eased

monetary.note: First rate cut Feb 2025 after 4.5 years

external_sector.note: FPI net near flat after massive outflows Oct 2024-Feb 2025

equity_markets.note: ATH in Sep; FPI sold record; India's IPO share 30% of global listings

debt_markets.note: India GBI-EM inclusion began Jun 2024 (max 10% weight phased over 10 months)

mutual_funds.note: MF industry AUM crossed Rs 66 lakh crore

key_events: FPI sold record Rs 1.12 lakh crore equity (Oct-Feb)
Election results Jun 4 — Nifty fell 4.7% single day

inflation.note: Inflation at 8-year low; well below RBI's lower tolerance

monetary.note: 125bps easing in FY26 — most aggressive since 2019

exchange_rate.note: INR weakened; RBI active in forward book

equity_markets.note: FY27 start — markets below ATH; RBI on hold at 5.25%

commodities.note: Gold at all-time highs globally ($3000+ USD)

key_events: New Income Tax Act 2025 effective Apr 1 2026
FPI sold record since 1991 — domestic investors cushioned
US Liberation Day tariffs Apr 2 — India relatively insulated
RBI forex reserves hit $728.5bn (Feb 2026 peak) then fell $40bn+
